text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's the day of the Champions Cup.<n>Victory here will
greatly raise Shinko<n>Windy's chances of being
awarded<n>Best Dirt Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She's highly motivated to carry out<n>her prank of
winning the award and<n>then refusing to accept it.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Everyone in the stands is eager tofind out whether her ability is for real.This is the moment she needs toshow her strength.
